text:
maria: Heads-up — saw steady RSS growth on dedicated-ci while running the streaming toolloop with ~1200 token context. Not classic alloc leak; looks like pages getting 'shadowed' in KV allocator after long sessions. Attaching quick repro and traces.

aj: repro? timeline?

maria: repro is in sandbox-03, job id tk-regen-421. Steps: start toolloop (repeat generate+toolcall ~50x), attach pmap every 60s. Heap doesn't show new objects, but RSS climbs ~200MB over 30min.

maria: quick gdb backtrace of top consumer thread:
```
#0  0x7f8a1b2 in kv_page_acquire+0x210
#1  0x7f8a3d9 in kv_slot_map_insert
#2  0x7f8a7e1 in streaming_tool_loop::process_chunk
#3  0x7f8b0af in thread_pool::worker
```

aj: that's interesting — slot_map_insert should reuse freed pages. Could be fragmentation preventing coalescing. Any slab stats?

maria: ran kv-stats endpoint, snippet: 
```
total_pages: 16384
free_pages: 480
pinned_pages: 12400
fragmentation_ratio: 0.65
largest_contiguous_free: 12
```

maria: pinned pages keeps creeping up during long context runs. Not obvious refs.

perf-bot: Attached perf profile: flamegraph at https://perf.internal/runs/2165432100. Top symbols: kv_page_acquire, page_fault_handler, memcpy_small.

olivia: @maria can you try force-evict on idle sessions? There's an evict path added last month that might be gated behind an inactivity check.

maria: did a quick patch that invokes eviction on every checkpoint: reduced RSS slope but didn't fully stop growth. Patch diff: 
```
- if (session.idle_for > 300s) evict(session)
+ evict(session)
```

maria: after patch, pinned_pages growth slowed but still +40MB over 1h.

kevin: could be reuse metadata leaking — slot headers not returned to slab. Any changes in kernel selection / batching recently?

maria: we rolled a batching heuristic change two weeks ago (adaptive batch expansion) but same repro on older build from last month. So unrelated.

aj: steps to isolate: 1) run with KV debug logging (kv.verbose=2) for one hour 2) take periodic slab histograms 3) collect page map (proc/pid/pagemap) for process 4) run heaptrack to confirm not app-level allocs.

maria: running now on sandbox-05 with debug. Logging is noisy but found repeated entries: 
```
[KV DEBUG] slot 0x7f9a3c pinned -> ghosted (owner=nil) at seq 4123
[GC] attempted reclaim 12 pages, reclaimed 0
[KV DEBUG] slot 0x7f9a3c reassigned -> new owner 0x12f
```

maria: ghosted slots appear to stay in 'shadow' state where they have a page mapping but no owner for several minutes. That's what I mean by 'shadow pages'.

aj: is page refcount >0 in kernel? pmap shows entries still mapped. Maybe we forgot to munmap on fallback path.

maria: grepping code path, fallback path in kv_reclaim() recent change returns early on EINTR before calling page_unmap(). Repro is consistent with that.

olivia: oof. That would explain lingering mapped pages. Can you open a small PR that ensures we unmap on error paths and add a test?

maria: will do. Quick experiment: patched kv_reclaim to call page_unmap in defer/cleanup. Restarted sandbox job; initial 30m shows flat RSS.

simon: nice. Can you add a unit test simulating EINTR in reclaim and assert no mapped pages after reclaim completes? Also add an integ test for longcontext streaming for 2h with checksum on pagemap.

maria: adding tests + changelog. PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/8764.

kevin: after merge, let's schedule canary on dedicated-prod for 24h with tracing enabled. If stable, backport to 1.18.x.

maria: agreed. Will push PR today. Thanks all :rocket: 

aj: great find. Follow-up: consider adding active eviction when fragmentation_ratio > 0.6 for long sessions; open a follow-up ticket.

maria: created ticket INF-3287 for adaptive eviction on fragmentation.

perf-bot: Canary job created: canary-2165432100-01, linked in #eng-sre.

maria: closing thread for now — will update when PR lands and canary results back.
